# Zachary Vorsteg

> Zachary Vorsteg is an AI automation consultant (fractional AI lead) based in West Palm Beach, Florida. He builds and runs AI workflow systems (lead intake and routing, call handling, CRMs and reporting) in his own live products, then installs the same kind of systems for owner-led Palm Beach County businesses, with a person approving anything that sends, spends or publishes. He has 5+ shipped products, including Trusenda on the App Store, CallsHandled, AdsHandled and CustomLab.ai. Finance background (FAU '20). He is a Florida real estate sales associate with Cornerstone Realty (SL3603483). Software and automation work is available remotely nationwide; property service areas depend on the engagement.

## Ways to work together

- [AI automation](https://zacharyvorsteg.com/ai-automation/): Intake, document work, reporting and connected workflows. Scope, timeline and ongoing responsibility are agreed before work starts.
- [Custom software](https://zacharyvorsteg.com/custom-software/): Applications, internal tools and integrations built around a defined business need.
- [Finance](https://zacharyvorsteg.com/finance/): Financial modeling, FP&A systems, scenario planning and pro formas.
- [Commercial real estate](https://zacharyvorsteg.com/commercial-real-estate/): Industrial, warehouse and flex property work through the applicable brokerage relationship.
- [AI Operating Layer](https://zacharyvorsteg.com/ai-operating-layer/): Direct involvement in the design and operation of business systems. Discuss fit, responsibilities and terms.
- [Production](https://zacharyvorsteg.com/production/): Selected reels, stills and motion work.

## Published prices

As published on each linked page, checked 2026-11-15. The linked page is the current source; prices can change.

- CustomLab.ai (https://customlab.ai/): free 30-minute fit call; AI Operations Audit $1,500 one-time; engagements start at $3,500 a month (90-day initial partnership, then month-to-month).
- CallsHandled (https://callshandled.ai/): Receptionist $297 a month with 300 answered call minutes; Service Desk $497 a month with 600 answered call minutes; cancel anytime.
- AdsHandled (https://adshandled.com/): $399 a month flat management fee; ad spend separate, paid directly to the ad platforms; first month of management free; no contracts.
- AI Operating Layer (https://zacharyvorsteg.com/ai-operating-layer/): Foundation engagements begin in the low five figures per year; Operating Layer and Embedded engagements run into six figures; priced annually against a written scope.
- A project scoped directly with Zach (https://zacharyvorsteg.com/ai-consulting-west-palm-beach/): no published starting price; quoted in writing before work starts; the first conversation is free.
